$$\begin{aligned}

&=\vec w^H\mathbf A\vec w+\vec w^H\mathbf B\vec h\\

y_t&=\vec w_\star^H(\vec x_t-\mathbf G^H\vec q_t).
\end{aligned}\tag{7-21}$$
